templates.why_chosen: Star, high-confidence matrix exemplar reading as a physical resource map: identical Hybrid Compute Tile cells surround one central Front End, with a callout zooming from one grid cell into its stacked analog-over-digital internal structure.
templates.what_to_learn: Use a matrix of identical tile cells to depict physical placement of replicated hardware around one shared control block, and zoom from a single selected cell into an exploded detail panel rather than expanding every cell, keeping the grid itself uncluttered.

templates.why_chosen: A uniform tile grid with one tile highlighted and exploded into an internal view via a callout wedge.
templates.what_to_learn: Highlight the source tile in the grid (different border/fill) before drawing the callout, so the reader knows which of the N tiles was expanded.
